description: Send raw key sequences to a pane (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+D, Enter, Escape, arrow keys, etc.). Uses tmux key names: C-c (Ctrl+C), C-d (Ctrl+D), Enter, Escape, Up, Down, Left, Right, BSpace, Tab, Space. Useful for interrupting builds, exiting REPLs, or navigating interactive programs.

keys.description: The key sequence to send (e.g. 'C-c' for Ctrl+C, 'C-d' for Ctrl+D, 'Enter', 'Escape', 'Up', 'q').

name: send_keys
